hook_formula: Underdog premise ('powerless kid at hero school') paired with high visual motion and rapid voiceover to hook viewers instantly.
story_arc: Setup: Protagonist fakes powers to impress his floating crush. Escalation: Subtle power nullification anomalies occur, culminating in a giant villain attack. Twist/Payoff: He discovers his real power is area power-cancellation, saves his crush, and gets accepted.

character_archetypes.outfit_style: Green hair, black and green striped long-sleeve shirt, dark trousers
Long dark hair, dark school blazer, pleated skirt, white knit socks
Red and yellow fire-themed superhero suit with flame headpiece

source_transcript: I'm the only kid at superhero school with no super power, so I've been faking one for a year to impress my crush. Her power is floating, and she can't turn it off. She's tied to her desk by the ankle. For laser eyes, I used two flashlights. For flying, a leaf blower. For super strength, a cardboard car. If anyone found out I'd be kicked out, but weird things kept happening. Every time I sat next to her, she stopped floating. The whole class said she liked me, and whenever I walked past the fire kid, his flames went out. Then a villain who grows as big as a building smashed through the wall. Every hero bounced off him. He snapped her rope and grabbed her. I ran straight at him. The closer I got, the smaller he got. When I reached him, he was normal size. She dropped into my arms. That's when I got it. I do have a power. Every power near me stops working. So she never liked me. It was just my power. I asked her out anyway. She said yes. Then she cut the rope off her ankle. Next to you, I don't need it.
